content.comment_body: Hello, when testing two or more [product_name] simple network programs using the green blocks, the outputs sometimes activate and sometimes do not, even after following the recommended procedures. The network simulation does not function correctly. Has anyone else experienced this? Thank you.
I haven't encountered this issue. Please review your network configuration, as this is frequently where problems arise. Regards, [user_name]

When I used an HMI screen, I discovered that under the Ethernet settings, enabling 'keep alive' and lowering the time to 1 second resulted in a faster response when activating outputs. I hope this information helps.

analysis.insight_summary: The initial post describes unpredictable behavior in a network simulation involving [product_name] software and network programs, with outputs not always activating correctly. Suggestions from other users point to network configuration issues rather than faults in the simulation software, highlighting a need for clearer guidance in the setup process to achieve consistent performance.
analysis.user_expectations: The user anticipates that the network simulation should reliably reproduce output activations according to programming across multiple [product_name] network programs.
